Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026 Out @bankofbaroda.bank.in

The Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026 has been released on the official website of Bank of Baroda for candidates who appeared in the Office Assistant (Peon) Prelims. The online preliminary examination was conducted on 22 and 23 February 2026 for the recruitment of 500 Office Assistant (Peon) posts in the sub-staff cadre. The result will be published in PDF format, containing the roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for the Mains exam.

Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026 PDF Download Link

The Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026 PDF download link is active at bankofbaroda.bank.in. Candidates can download the official Merit List PDF of candidates selected for Mains to check their qualifying status. We have updated the direct Result PDF download link below.

Download Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026 PDF

How to Download BOB Peon Result 2026?

The result has been released in the form of a PDF merit list containing the registration numbers of shortlisted candidates. To download the Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026 from the bank’s official website, follow the steps given below.

  • Visit the official website of Bank of Baroda at bankofbaroda.in.
  • Go to the Careers section on the homepage.
  • Find the link titled “Recruitment of Office Assistant (Peon) – Result 2026.”
  • Click on the Prelims result link.
  • The Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026 PDF will appear on the screen.
  • Use Ctrl + F and enter your roll number or registration number.
  • Download and save the PDF for future reference.

Details Mentioned on Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026

After downloading the Result PDF, make sure to verify the following information printed on it:

  1. Name of the Bank
  2. Name of the post (Office Assistant Peon)
  3. Registration Numbers of candidates qualified in Prelims
  4. Category (if applicable)
  5. Examination name and year
  6. State
  7. Instructions regarding the next stage of selection

BOB Peon Scorecard 2026 PDF

The scorecard will be released within 10 to 15 days of the release of the BOB Peon Result 2026. Candidates can download their individual scorecard to check the breakdown of marks obtained in each section. The Bank of Baroda Peon Scorecard will be available on the candidates’ login portal at bankofbaroda.bank.in.

Bank of Baroda Peon Mains Exam Date 2026 Out

Along with the official Result, the BOB Peon Mains Exam Date 2026 has also been announced. The Online Main Examination will be conducted on 23rd March 2026. The exam schedule and admit card will be released 7 to 10 days before the scheduled exam date. The details about the Mains examination will be sent to the candidates’ registered e-mail IDs.

Event Date
BOB Peon Online Main Examination 23rd March 2026

What’s Next After Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026 Released?

Candidates who qualify in the Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026 will move to the next stage of the recruitment process, which is the Mains Examination. Note that the Prelims is only qualifying in nature. Final selection is made based on the performance of candidates in the Mains and Language Proficiency Test. Appointment letters will be issued to finally appointed candidates.

Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. When will the Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026 be released?

Ans. The Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026 has been released on 11th March 2026.

Q2. Where can candidates check the BOB Peon Result 2026?

Ans. Candidates can check the BOB Office Assistant Result 2026 on the official Bank of Baroda website, bankofbaroda.in, under the Careers section. The result is released in PDF format containing the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates.

Q3. How can I check my Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026?

Ans. Candidates can check their Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026 by downloading the result PDF from the official website and searching their roll number using the Ctrl + F option. If the roll number appears in the merit list, the candidate has qualified for the next stage.

Q4. What details are mentioned in the BOB Peon Result 2026 PDF?

Ans. The BOB Peon Result 2026 PDF contains the state wise list of registration number of qualified candidates and instructions regarding the next stage of the recruitment process.

Q5. What happens after the Bank of Baroda Peon Result 2026 is declared?

Ans. After the BOB Peon Result 2026 is released, candidates who have qualified will now appear for the Online Main Examination.
